passages.text: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gives His Law.
Some people walk in the Law of the LORD.
These people live in a blameless way.
God calls these people blessed.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֥י תְמִֽימֵי־ דָ֑רֶךְ הַֽ֝הֹלְכִ֗ים בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
passages.sermon:
God gives blessings to certain people.
These people keep His testimonies.
They obey what God has said.
They also seek God.
They do this with all their heart.
They look for God with complete devotion.
God blesses these people.
passages.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵ֥י עֵדֹתָ֗יו בְּכָל־ לֵ֥ב יִדְרְשֽׁוּהוּ׃

passages.text: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
passages.sermon: These people do no iniquity.\r\nThey walk in God's ways.
passages.original: אַ֭ף לֹֽא־ פָעֲל֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּדְרָכָ֥יו הָלָֽכוּ׃

passages.text: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
passages.sermon: God gives His precepts.\r\nGod commands us to keep His precepts.\r\nGod wants us to keep His precepts diligently.
passages.original: אַ֭תָּה צִוִּ֥יתָה פִקֻּדֶ֗יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
passages.sermon:
The speaker desires to obey God.
The speaker wants his actions to follow God's statutes.
He wishes his ways were firmly set to keep God's laws.
He longs for commitment to God's commands.
passages.original: אַ֭חֲלַי יִכֹּ֥נוּ דְרָכָ֗י לִשְׁמֹ֥ר חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
passages.sermon:
God gives commandments.
\r\nGod wants people to obey His commandments.
\r\nI look at all of God's commandments.
\r\nIf I keep God's commandments, I will not feel shame.
\r\nI will not be ashamed when I consider all of God's commandments.
passages.original: אָ֥ז לֹא־ אֵב֑וֹשׁ בְּ֝הַבִּיטִ֗י אֶל־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
passages.sermon:
I will praise You.
I will have an upright heart.
I will praise You when I learn Your righteous judgments.
Your judgments are righteous.
passages.original: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לָמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
passages.sermon: I will keep Your statutes.\r\nDo not utterly forsake me.
passages.original: אֶת־ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑ר אַֽל־ תַּעַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד־ מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
passages.sermon:
A young man wants to keep his way pure.
He asks how he can do this.
He can keep his way pure by guarding it.
He must guard his way according to God's word.
passages.original: בַּמֶּ֣ה יְזַכֶּה־ נַּ֭עַר אֶת־ אָרְח֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
passages.sermon: I have sought You with all my heart.\r\nDo not let me stray from Your commandments.
passages.original: בְּכָל־ לִבִּ֥י דְרַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אַל־ תַּ֝שְׁגֵּ֗נִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
passages.sermon:
I have hidden Your word in my heart.
I do this so I will not sin against You.
Your word guides me.
Your word protects me from sin.
I keep Your word close inside me.
passages.original: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶֽחֱטָא־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is blessed.
The LORD is God.
I ask the LORD to teach me His statutes.
Statutes are God's commands and laws.
I want to learn God's statutes from Him.
passages.original: בָּר֖וּךְ אַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֗ה לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
passages.sermon:
I speak with my lips.
I tell all the judgments from Your mouth.
I proclaim every decision You have spoken.
I use my words to declare what You have commanded.
passages.original: בִּשְׂפָתַ֥י סִפַּ֑רְתִּי כֹּ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker finds joy in the way of God's testimonies.
The speaker rejoices in God's testimonies.
The speaker values this joy as much as all riches.
passages.original: בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ שַׂ֗שְׂתִּי כְּעַ֣ל כָּל־ הֽוֹן׃

passages.text: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
passages.sermon:
I will meditate on Your precepts.
I will regard Your ways.
You, Lord, give precepts.
You, Lord, have ways for me to follow.
passages.original: בְּפִקֻּדֶ֥יךָ אָשִׂ֑יחָה וְ֝אַבִּ֗יטָה אֹרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
passages.sermon: The speaker addresses God.\r\nThe speaker delights in God's statutes.\r\nThe speaker does not forget God's word.
passages.original: בְּחֻקֹּתֶ֥יךָ אֶֽשְׁתַּעֲשָׁ֑ע לֹ֭א אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
passages.sermon:
God, you are the giver of life.
I am your servant.
Please treat me with great kindness.
Let me live because of your goodness.
I will obey your word.
I will keep your commands.
passages.original: גְּמֹ֖ל עַֽל־ עַבְדְּךָ֥ אֶֽחְיֶ֗ה וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה דְבָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses God.
The speaker asks God to open his eyes.
The speaker wants to see wondrous things.
These wondrous things are in God's law.
passages.original: גַּל־ עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
passages.sermon:
I am a stranger on the earth.
I do not belong here.
I live as a foreigner among people.
God, do not hide Your commandments from me.
Let me know Your commands.
I need Your guidance.
passages.original: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל־ תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a servant of God.
The speaker has a soul.
The soul feels a strong desire.
The soul longs for God's judgments.
This longing fills the soul completely.
The longing does not stop.
The longing continues at all times.
God's judgments are always the focus of this desire.
passages.original: גָּרְסָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י לְתַאֲבָ֑ה אֶֽל־ מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ בְכָל־ עֵֽת׃

passages.text: You rebuke the arrogant— the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
passages.sermon: God rebukes the arrogant.\r\nThe arrogant are cursed.\r\nThey stray from God's commandments.
passages.original: גָּ֭עַרְתָּ זֵדִ֣ים אֲרוּרִ֑ים הַ֝שֹּׁגִים מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
passages.sermon:
I ask You, God, to take away my scorn.
I ask You to remove my contempt.
I have kept Your testimonies.
I have obeyed Your commands.
That is why I ask You to remove my shame and dishonor.
passages.original: גַּ֣ל מֵֽ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃

passages.text: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
passages.sermon:
Rulers sit together.  
They speak against me.  
I am Your servant.  
I meditate on Your statutes.
passages.original: גַּ֤ם יָֽשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.
passages.sermon:
God gave testimonies.
\r\nThese testimonies bring me delight.
\r\nThese testimonies give me joy.
\r\nThese testimonies guide me.
\r\nThese testimonies act as my counselors.
passages.original: גַּֽם־ עֵ֭דֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֗י אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲצָתִֽי׃

passages.text: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is God's servant.
\r\nThe servant feels very low.
\r\nThe servant says, "My soul clings to the dust."
\r\nThe servant asks God to give life.
\r\nThe servant says, "Revive me as You have promised in Your word."
passages.original: דָּֽבְקָ֣ה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשִׁ֑י חַ֝יֵּ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
passages.sermon:
I spoke to God about my actions.
God listened to me.
God answered me.
I ask God to teach me His statutes.
God’s statutes are His commands and laws.
I want to learn and follow God’s ways.
passages.original: דְּרָכַ֣י סִ֭פַּרְתִּי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֗נִי לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
passages.sermon:
God, You give precepts.
Your precepts show the right way.
Help me understand the way of Your precepts.
When I understand, I will think about Your wonders.
Your wonders are great and amazing.
passages.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ־ פִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָשִׂ֗יחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
passages.sermon:
I feel deep sorrow in my soul.
My soul grows weak from grief.
God, give me strength.
Strengthen me as You have promised in Your word.
passages.original: דָּלְפָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִתּוּגָ֑ה קַ֝יְּמֵ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
passages.sermon:
God, I ask You to take me away from the path of deceit.
I do not want to follow lies.
Please give me Your law as a gift.
I need Your teaching to guide me.
Your law shows me the right way.
passages.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ־ שֶׁ֭קֶר הָסֵ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ חָנֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
passages.sermon: I have chosen the way of truth.\r\nI have set Your ordinances before me.
passages.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ־ אֱמוּנָ֥ה בָחָ֑רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ שִׁוִּֽיתִי׃

passages.text: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
passages.sermon: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD.\r\nDo not let me be put to shame.
passages.original: דָּבַ֥קְתִּי בְעֵֽדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל־ תְּבִישֵֽׁנִי׃

passages.text: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
passages.sermon: I run in the path of Your commandments.\r\nYou, LORD, will enlarge my heart.
passages.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ־ מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אָר֑וּץ כִּ֖י תַרְחִ֣יב לִבִּֽי׃

passages.text: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the one I address.
The LORD gives statutes.
I ask the LORD to teach me the way of His statutes.
I will keep the LORD’s statutes.
I will keep them to the end.
passages.original: הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב׃

passages.text: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
passages.sermon: The speaker asks God for understanding.\r\nThe speaker wants to obey God's law.\r\nThe speaker promises to keep God's law with all his heart.
passages.original: הֲ֭בִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָ֥ה תֽוֹרָתֶ֗ךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶ֥נָּה בְכָל־ לֵֽב׃

passages.text: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker asks the LORD to guide him.
The speaker wants to walk in the path of the LORD’s commandments.
The speaker finds delight in the LORD’s commandments.
passages.original: הַ֭דְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִ֣יב מִצְוֺתֶ֑יךָ כִּי־ ב֥וֹ חָפָֽצְתִּי׃

passages.text: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
passages.sermon:
God, You give testimonies.
Your testimonies are true.
Turn my heart to Your testimonies.
Do not let my heart desire selfish gain.
Do not let me seek after riches.
Let my heart love what You say.
passages.original: הַט־ לִ֭בִּי אֶל־ עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ וְאַ֣ל אֶל־ בָּֽצַע׃

passages.text: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
passages.sermon:
God, you are the one I pray to.
I ask you to turn my eyes away from worthless things.
Do not let me look at things that have no value.
Give me life through your ways.
Let your word revive me.
passages.original: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי מֵרְא֣וֹת שָׁ֑וְא בִּדְרָכֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
passages.sermon:
God, you have a servant.
I am your servant.
Give strength to your word in me.
Let your word stand firm in my life.
Let your word cause me to fear you.
Let your word teach me reverence for you.
passages.original: הָקֵ֣ם לְ֭עַבְדְּךָ אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לְיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
passages.sermon:
God, you are righteous.
\r\nYou make good judgments.
\r\nI am your servant.
\r\nI feel disgrace.
\r\nI am afraid of this disgrace.
\r\nPlease take away my disgrace.
\r\nYour judgments are always good.
passages.original: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִֽים׃

passages.text: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses God.
The speaker is God's servant.
The speaker longs for God's precepts.
The speaker desires to follow God's commands.
The speaker asks God to revive him.
The speaker asks God to give him life.
The speaker wants God to do this through God's righteousness.
passages.original: הִ֭נֵּה תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לְפִקֻּדֶ֑יךָ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You are loving and faithful.
Let Your loving devotion come to me.
You save Your people.
Give me Your salvation.
You have made a promise.
Give me salvation as You promised.
passages.original: וִֽיבֹאֻ֣נִי חֲסָדֶ֣ךָ יְהוָ֑ה תְּ֝שֽׁוּעָתְךָ֗ כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist faces someone who taunts him.
The psalmist wants to answer the one who taunts him.
The psalmist trusts in God's word.
Because the psalmist trusts God's word, he can answer his mocker.
passages.original: וְאֶֽעֱנֶ֣ה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָ֑ר כִּֽי־ בָ֝טַחְתִּי בִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
passages.sermon:
God, You are the Lord.
Your word is truth.
Do not let Your word of truth leave my mouth.
I hope in Your judgments.
I trust what You decide is right.
passages.original: וְֽאַל־ תַּצֵּ֬ל מִפִּ֣י דְבַר־ אֱמֶ֣ת עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

passages.text: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a faithful servant of God.
The speaker promises to obey God's law.
The speaker will obey God's law always.
The speaker will obey God's law forever.
The speaker will obey God's law without end.
passages.original: וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֖ה תוֹרָתְךָ֥ תָמִ֗יד לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

passages.text: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist says, “I will walk in freedom.”
The psalmist has sought God’s precepts.
Because the psalmist has sought God’s precepts, the psalmist will walk in freedom.
passages.original: וְאֶתְהַלְּכָ֥ה בָרְחָבָ֑ה כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי׃

passages.text: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
passages.sermon: I will speak about Your testimonies.\r\nI will speak before kings.\r\nI will not feel shame.
passages.original: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

passages.text: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
passages.sermon: I love Your commandments.\r\nI delight in Your commandments.
passages.original: וְאֶשְׁתַּֽעֲשַׁ֥ע בְּמִצְוֺתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהָֽבְתִּי׃

passages.text: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.
passages.sermon: I love Your commandments.\r\nI lift up my hands to Your commandments.\r\nI meditate on Your statutes.
passages.original: וְאֶשָּֽׂא־ כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל־ מִ֭צְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
passages.sermon:
God, you have a servant.
\r\nYou spoke a word to your servant.
\r\nYou gave your servant hope through your word.
\r\nRemember your word to your servant.
passages.original: זְכֹר־ דָּבָ֥ר לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ עַ֝֗ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽחַלְתָּֽנִי׃

passages.text: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
passages.sermon:
I feel pain and trouble.
I find comfort in this time.
Your promise gives me life.
Your word brings me hope when I suffer.
passages.original: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעָנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃

passages.text: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
passages.sermon:
Arrogant people mock me very much.
They show me great contempt.
I do not leave Your law.
I remain faithful to Your law.
passages.original: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תּֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃

passages.text: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You are eternal.
You have given judgments from long ago.
I remember Your judgments.
I find comfort in Your judgments.
passages.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖יךָ מֵעוֹלָ֥ם׀ יְהוָ֗ה וָֽאֶתְנֶחָֽם׃

passages.text: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
passages.sermon:
I feel rage.
The wicked cause this rage.
These wicked people reject Your law.
Their rejection of Your law fills me with anger.
passages.original: זַלְעָפָ֣ה אֲ֭חָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים עֹ֝זְבֵ֗י תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
passages.sermon:
God gave me His statutes.
I live as a pilgrim on earth.
I treat God's statutes as songs.
I sing God's statutes in my temporary home.
passages.original: זְ֭מִרוֹת הָֽיוּ־ לִ֥י חֻקֶּ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית מְגוּרָֽי׃

passages.text: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
passages.sermon: I remember Your name, O LORD, at night.\r\nI do this so I can keep Your law.
passages.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
passages.sermon: I obey Your precepts.\r\nThis is my practice.
passages.original: זֹ֥את הָֽיְתָה־ לִּ֑י כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃

passages.text: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
passages.sermon: The LORD is my portion.\r\nI have said this.\r\nI have promised to keep Your words.
passages.original: חֶלְקִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אָמַ֗רְתִּי לִשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
passages.sermon:
I seek You, LORD, with all my heart.
I ask You to show me grace.
You have made a promise.
I ask You to be gracious as You promised.
passages.original: חִלִּ֣יתִי פָנֶ֣יךָ בְכָל־ לֵ֑ב חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a believer in the LORD.
The believer thinks about his actions.
He examines his ways.
He decides to change his direction.
He turns his steps toward the LORD’s testimonies.
He chooses to follow God’s teachings.
passages.original: חִשַּׁ֥בְתִּי דְרָכָ֑י וָאָשִׁ֥יבָה רַ֝גְלַ֗י אֶל־ עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
passages.sermon:
I wanted to obey Your commandments.
I acted quickly.
I did not wait.
I did not hesitate.
I hurried to keep Your commandments.
passages.original: חַ֭שְׁתִּי וְלֹ֣א הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְתִּי לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
passages.sermon:
Wicked people try to bind me.
They use ropes to hold me.
I do not forget Your law.
I remember what You have commanded.
Your law stays in my mind, even when I suffer.
passages.original: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

passages.text: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
passages.sermon: I rise at midnight.\r\nI give You thanks, O LORD.\r\nYou make righteous judgments.
passages.original: חֲצֽוֹת־ לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
passages.sermon: I am a friend to all who fear God.\r\nI am a friend to all who keep God's precepts.
passages.original: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You fill the earth with loving devotion.
Your kindness covers all the world.
Teach me Your statutes.
Show me Your laws.
passages.original: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You are good.
You act with goodness toward me.
I am Your servant.
You do what You promised in Your word.
passages.original: ט֭וֹב עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִֽם־ עַבְדְּךָ֑ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to the LORD.
The psalmist asks God to teach him.
He asks for good judgment.
He asks for knowledge.
The psalmist believes in God's commandments.
passages.original: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃

passages.text: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
passages.sermon:
I went astray before I was afflicted.
I did not follow God's way.
God allowed affliction to come to me.
Now I keep God's word.
I obey what God says.
passages.original: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃

passages.text: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
passages.sermon: God, You are good.\r\nYou do what is good.\r\nTeach me Your statutes.
passages.original: טוֹב־ אַתָּ֥ה וּמֵטִ֗יב לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
passages.sermon:
Arrogant people told lies about me.
They tried to harm my reputation.
I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
I obey Your commands completely.
passages.original: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכָל־ לֵ֤ב׀ אֱצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Their hearts are hard and callous, but I delight in Your law.
passages.sermon:
Some people have hard and callous hearts.
They do not feel or care.
I am different.
I find joy in Your law.
Your law gives me delight.
passages.original: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃

passages.text: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
passages.sermon:
God allowed me to suffer.
This suffering was good for me.
Through my suffering, I learned God's statutes.
God's statutes are His laws and commands.
I gained understanding of God's ways because of my affliction.
passages.original: טֽוֹב־ לִ֥י כִֽי־ עֻנֵּ֑יתִי לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶלְמַ֥ד חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
passages.sermon:
God, You speak Your law.
Your law is precious to me.
Your law is better than gold.
Your law is better than silver.
Your law is worth more than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
passages.original: טֽוֹב־ לִ֥י תֽוֹרַת־ פִּ֑יךָ מֵ֝אַלְפֵ֗י זָהָ֥ב וָכָֽסֶף׃

passages.text: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
passages.sermon:
God, You made me.
You formed me.
You shaped who I am.
You created me with Your own hands.
Give me understanding.
Help me learn Your commandments.
I want to know what You command.
I want to obey You.
passages.original: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
passages.sermon: People who fear God see me.\r\nThey rejoice.\r\nI have hoped in God's word.
passages.original: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

passages.text: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is righteous.
The LORD gives judgments that are right.
I know this, O LORD.
You have afflicted me.
You did this in faithfulness.
passages.original: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־ צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃

passages.text: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker is God's servant.
The speaker asks for God's loving devotion.
The speaker wants comfort from God.
The speaker asks God to comfort him.
The speaker asks God to do this according to His promise.
God made a promise to His servant.
The speaker trusts God's promise.
passages.original: יְהִי־ נָ֣א חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְנַחֲמֵ֑נִי כְּאִמְרָתְךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
passages.sermon:
God, You are compassionate.
I ask for Your compassion to come to me.
Your compassion gives me life.
I delight in Your law.
Your law brings me joy.
passages.original: יְבֹא֣וּנִי רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ וְאֶֽחְיֶ֑ה כִּי־ תֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ שַֽׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃

passages.text: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
passages.sermon:
The arrogant people oppose me.
They use lies to harm me.
May these arrogant people feel shame.
They twist the truth against me.
I will think deeply about Your commands.
I will focus on Your precepts.
passages.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־ שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
passages.sermon:
This prayer speaks to God.
The speaker asks God for help.
The speaker wants people who fear God to come to him.
These people respect and honor God.
They know God's testimonies.
The speaker wants these faithful people to turn to him.
passages.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לִ֣י יְרֵאֶ֑יךָ וְיָדְעוּ עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
passages.sermon:
God, You give statutes.
\r\nI want my heart to be blameless.
\r\nI want to follow Your statutes.
\r\nIf my heart is blameless, I will not be put to shame.
passages.original: יְהִֽי־ לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

passages.text: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
passages.sermon:
I am a servant of God.
My soul longs deeply for Your salvation.
I feel weak because I wait so much for You to save me.
I put my hope in Your word.
I trust what You have promised.
passages.original: כָּלְתָ֣ה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ נַפְשִׁ֑י לִדְבָרְךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

passages.text: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist waits for God’s promise.
The psalmist looks for God’s word.
The psalmist’s eyes grow weak from waiting.
The psalmist asks God a question.
The psalmist says, “When will You comfort me?”
passages.original: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
passages.sermon:
I am suffering.
I feel weak and worn out.
I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke.
I do not forget Your statutes.
I remember Your commands.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

passages.text: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
passages.sermon:
I am Your servant.
I wait for You.
How many days must I wait?
My persecutors attack me.
When will You judge them?
passages.original: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי־ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
passages.sermon:
Arrogant people oppose me.
They dig pits for me.
They act against Your law.
They do not follow Your teaching.
passages.original: כָּֽרוּ־ לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
passages.sermon: God, all Your commandments are faithful.\r\nPeople persecute me without cause.\r\nHelp me.
passages.original: כָּל־ מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אֱמוּנָ֑ה שֶׁ֖קֶר רְדָפ֣וּנִי עָזְרֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
passages.sermon:
Evil people attacked me.
They almost destroyed me.
I almost disappeared from the earth.
I did not abandon Your commands.
I remained faithful to Your precepts.
passages.original: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא־ עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
passages.sermon:
God, You show loving devotion.
Give me life because of Your loving devotion.
I want to obey Your words.
I will keep the testimony that comes from Your mouth.
passages.original: כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּ֑נִי וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵד֥וּת פִּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
God’s word lasts forever.
God’s word stands firm in the heavens.
God’s word never changes.
God’s word is always true.
passages.original: לְעוֹלָ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝בָרְךָ֗ נִצָּ֥ב בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is faithful.
His faithfulness lasts through every generation.
The Lord created the earth.
The earth stands firm because of Him.
passages.original: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמֽוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃

passages.text: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God gives ordinances.
God’s ordinances remain firm today.
All things serve God.
All things are God’s servants.
passages.original: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
passages.sermon:
God gave His law.
\r\nI found delight in God's law.
\r\nI suffered affliction.
\r\nIf I had not delighted in God's law, I would have perished.
\r\nGod's law saved me during my suffering.
passages.original: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעָנְיִֽי׃

passages.text: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
passages.sermon:
God gives precepts.
God’s precepts are His commands and instructions.
I will never forget God’s precepts.
God’s precepts have revived me.
God’s precepts have given me life.
passages.original: לְ֭עוֹלָם לֹא־ אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗ם חִיִּיתָֽנִי׃

passages.text: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
passages.sermon: I belong to You.\r\nSave me.\r\nI have sought Your precepts.
passages.original: לְֽךָ־ אֲ֭נִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי׃

passages.text: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
passages.sermon:
The wicked want to destroy me.
They wait for me.
I think about Your testimonies.
I focus on what You have said.
Your words guide me.
passages.original: לִ֤י קִוּ֣וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לְאַבְּדֵ֑נִי עֵ֝דֹתֶ֗יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָֽן׃

passages.text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.
passages.sermon: I have seen that all perfection has a limit.\r\nYour commandment has no limit.\r\nYour commandment is very broad.
passages.original: לְֽכָל תִּ֭כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָתְךָ֣ מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
passages.sermon:
I love Your law.
I think about it all day.
Your law fills my thoughts.
Your law guides me always.
passages.original: מָֽה־ אָהַ֥בְתִּי תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ כָּל־ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם הִ֣יא שִׂיחָתִֽי׃

passages.text: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
passages.sermon:
God gives commandments.
God’s commandments are always with me.
God’s commandments make me wise.
I am wiser than my enemies because of God’s commandments.
passages.original: מֵ֭אֹ֣יְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵ֣נִי מִצְוֺתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם הִיא־ לִֽי׃

passages.text: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist says he has more insight than all his teachers.
He explains the reason.
He meditates on God's testimonies.
God's testimonies give him understanding.
passages.original: מִכָּל־ מְלַמְּדַ֥י הִשְׂכַּ֑לְתִּי כִּ֥י עֵ֝דְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽֿי׃

passages.text: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
passages.sermon:
God gives His precepts to His people.
I obey God's precepts.
I gain understanding because I obey God's precepts.
I discern more than the elders.
Obedience to God's precepts gives me greater insight than the elders have.
passages.original: מִזְּקֵנִ֥ים אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃

passages.text: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a faithful servant of God.
The speaker avoids every evil path.
The speaker keeps his feet from walking in evil ways.
The speaker does this so he can obey God's word.
The speaker wants to remain faithful to God's commands.
He chooses good so he can keep God's word.
passages.original: מִכָּל־ אֹ֣רַח רָ֭ע כָּלִ֣אתִי רַגְלָ֑י לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
passages.sermon: God teaches me.\r\nI have not turned away from God's ordinances.\r\nI follow God's commands because He teaches me directly.
passages.original: מִמִּשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לֹא־ סָ֑רְתִּי כִּֽי־ אַ֝תָּ֗ה הוֹרֵתָֽנִי׃

passages.text: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
passages.sermon: God’s words are very sweet to me.\r\nI taste God’s words and find them pleasant.\r\nGod’s words are sweeter than honey in my mouth.
passages.original: מַה־ נִּמְלְצ֣וּ לְ֭חִכִּי אִמְרָתֶ֗ךָ מִדְּבַ֥שׁ לְפִֽי׃

passages.text: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
passages.sermon:
God gives precepts.
\r\nI study Your precepts.
\r\nYour precepts give me understanding.
\r\nI hate every false way.
\r\nI hate false ways because I understand Your precepts.
passages.original: מִפִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן עַל־ כֵּ֝֗ן שָׂנֵ֤אתִי׀ כָּל־ אֹ֬רַח שָֽׁקֶר׃

passages.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
passages.sermon:
God’s word gives guidance.
God’s word is like a lamp.
The lamp shines on my feet.
God’s word shows me where to step.
God’s word is also like a light.
The light shines on my path.
God’s word helps me see the way forward.
passages.original: נֵר־ לְרַגְלִ֥י דְבָרֶ֑ךָ וְ֝א֗וֹר לִנְתִיבָתִֽי׃

passages.text: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is committed to God.
The speaker made a promise.
The speaker confirmed this promise.
The promise is to obey God's righteous judgments.
The speaker will keep God's righteous judgments.
passages.original: נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי וָאֲקַיֵּ֑מָה לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
passages.sermon:
I am suffering greatly.
O LORD, I am afflicted.
Give me life according to Your word.
Your word can revive me.
passages.original: נַעֲנֵ֥יתִי עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד יְ֝הוָ֗ה חַיֵּ֥נִי כִדְבָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, I speak to You now.
I offer words from my mouth freely.
Please accept these offerings.
Teach me Your judgments.
Show me what is right in Your eyes.
passages.original: נִדְב֣וֹת פִּ֭י רְצֵה־ נָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
passages.sermon:
I am always in danger.  
My life is always at risk.  
I do not forget Your law.  
I remember what You have commanded.  
I keep Your teachings in my mind.
passages.original: נַפְשִׁ֣י בְכַפִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד וְ֝תֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

passages.text: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
passages.sermon:
The wicked set a trap for me.
They want to harm me.
I do not leave Your commands.
I follow Your precepts always.
passages.original: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑י וּ֝מִפִּקּוּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי׃

passages.text: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
passages.sermon:
God, You have given me Your testimonies.
Your testimonies belong to me forever.
Your testimonies are my heritage.
Your testimonies bring joy to my heart.
passages.original: נָחַ֣לְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָ֑ם כִּֽי־ שְׂשׂ֖וֹן לִבִּ֣י הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
passages.sermon:
I have chosen to obey Your statutes.
I have set my heart to do this.
I will keep Your statutes always.
I will obey them to the very end.
passages.original: נָטִ֣יתִי לִ֭בִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת חֻקֶּ֗יךָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֵֽקֶב׃

passages.text: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
passages.sermon: I am the speaker in this passage.\r\nI despise people who are double-minded.\r\nI love Your law.
passages.original: סֵעֲפִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ אָהָֽבְתִּי׃

passages.text: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
passages.sermon: God, You are my hiding place.\r\nYou are my shield.\r\nI put my hope in Your word.
passages.original: סִתְרִ֣י וּמָגִנִּ֣י אָ֑תָּה לִדְבָרְךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

passages.text: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
passages.sermon: Evildoers, go away from me.\r\nI want to obey the commandments of my God.
passages.original: סֽוּרוּ־ מִמֶּ֥נִּי מְרֵעִ֑ים וְ֝אֶצְּרָ֗ה מִצְוֺ֥ת אֱלֹהָֽי׃

passages.text: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
passages.sermon:
God, You made promises to me.
You speak words that give life.
I ask You to support me.
If You support me, I will live.
I hope in You.
Do not let me be put to shame because of my hope.
passages.original: סָמְכֵ֣נִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ֣ וְאֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וְאַל־ תְּ֝בִישֵׁ֗נִי מִשִּׂבְרִֽי׃

passages.text: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
passages.sermon:
God, You have power to help me.
Please uphold me.
If You uphold me, I will be safe.
I will always pay attention to Your laws.
passages.original: סְעָדֵ֥נִי וְאִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה וְאֶשְׁעָ֖ה בְחֻקֶּ֣יךָ תָמִֽיד׃

passages.text: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
passages.sermon:
God rejects all who stray from His statutes.
These people turn away from God's commands.
Their deceit is worthless.
Their lies have no value.
passages.original: סָ֭לִיתָ כָּל־ שׁוֹגִ֣ים מֵחֻקֶּ֑יךָ כִּי־ שֶׁ֝֗קֶר תַּרְמִיתָֽם׃

passages.text: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
passages.sermon:
God removes all wicked people from the earth.
God treats the wicked like dross.
Dross is the waste left after refining metal.
God’s actions show He rejects evil.
Because God rejects evil, I love His testimonies.
God’s testimonies are His laws and teachings.
I value God’s testimonies because they are pure and true.
passages.original: סִגִ֗ים הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ כָל־ רִשְׁעֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ לָ֝כֵ֗ן אָהַ֥בְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
passages.sermon:
God is holy and powerful.
I feel awe when I think of God.
My body trembles because I fear God.
I am afraid of God's judgments.
God's judgments are just and true.
passages.original: סָמַ֣ר מִפַּחְדְּךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י וּֽמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ יָרֵֽאתִי׃

passages.text: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a servant of God.
\r\nThe speaker has acted with justice.
\r\nThe speaker has done what is right.
\r\nThe speaker asks God for help.
\r\nThe speaker says, "Do not leave me."
\r\nThe speaker does not want to be left to oppressors.
passages.original: עָ֭שִׂיתִי מִשְׁפָּ֣ט וָצֶ֑דֶק בַּל־ תַּ֝נִּיחֵ֗נִי לְעֹֽשְׁקָֽי׃

passages.text: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
passages.sermon:
God, You are powerful and just.
I am Your servant.
Please guarantee my well-being.
Do not let arrogant people oppress me.
passages.original: עֲרֹ֣ב עַבְדְּךָ֣ לְט֑וֹב אַֽל־ יַעַשְׁקֻ֥נִי זֵדִֽים׃

passages.text: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
passages.sermon:
I look for Your salvation.
I wait for You to save me.
I watch for Your righteous promise.
My eyes grow tired as I wait.
I long for You to fulfill Your word.
passages.original: עֵ֭ינַי כָּל֣וּ לִֽישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְאִמְרַ֥ת צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
passages.sermon:
God, You are loving and devoted.
I am Your servant.
Treat me with Your loving devotion.
Teach me Your statutes.
passages.original: עֲשֵׂ֖ה עִם־ עַבְדְּךָ֥ כְחַסְדֶּ֗ךָ וְחֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
passages.sermon:
I am Your servant.
I serve You, Lord.
Give me understanding.
Help me to know Your testimonies.
Let me learn what You have done.
Let me understand Your words and Your works.
passages.original: עַבְדְּךָ־ אָ֥נִי הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אֵדְעָ֗ה עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
passages.sermon: The LORD must act now.\r\nPeople have broken God's law.
passages.original: עֵ֭ת לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה הֵ֝פֵ֗רוּ תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
passages.sermon:
I love Your commandments.
I love them more than gold.
I love them more than the purest gold.
Your commandments are more valuable to me than any wealth.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֭ן אָהַ֣בְתִּי מִצְוֺתֶ֑יךָ מִזָּהָ֥ב וּמִפָּֽז׃

passages.text: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
passages.sermon:
I admire all Your precepts.
I see that Your precepts are right.
I hate every false way.
I reject every path that is not true.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ כָּל־ פִּקּ֣וּדֵי כֹ֣ל יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי כָּל־ אֹ֖רַח שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃

passages.text: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
passages.sermon:
God gives testimonies.
God’s testimonies are wonderful.
I see that God’s testimonies are wonderful.
Therefore, I obey God’s testimonies.
passages.original: פְּלָא֥וֹת עֵדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ עַל־ כֵּ֝֗ן נְצָרָ֥תַם נַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
passages.sermon:
God speaks through His words.
His words open up and reveal truth.
His words give light.
His words help people understand.
Even simple people learn from His words.
passages.original: פֵּ֖תַח דְּבָרֶ֥יךָ יָאִ֗יר מֵבִ֥ין פְּתָיִֽים׃

passages.text: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
passages.sermon:
I am a servant of God.
I open my mouth wide.
I pant for breath.
I long for Your commandments.
I desire Your commands deeply.
passages.original: פִּֽי־ פָ֭עַרְתִּי וָאֶשְׁאָ֑פָה כִּ֖י לְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ יָאָֽבְתִּי׃

passages.text: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
passages.sermon:
God, You are merciful to those who love Your name.
Turn to me.
Show me mercy.
Treat me as You treat those who love You.
passages.original: פְּנֵה־ אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
passages.sermon:
God, you are holy and righteous.
I am your servant.
Guide my steps by your word.
Direct everything I do by your commands.
Do not let any sin control me.
Keep me free from evil.
passages.original: פְּ֭עָמַי הָכֵ֣ן בְּאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ וְֽאַל־ תַּשְׁלֶט־ בִּ֥י כָל־ אָֽוֶן׃

passages.text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
passages.sermon:
God, You are righteous.
You are upright in all Your judgments.
People oppress me.
Redeem me from the oppression of people.
Then I will keep Your precepts.
passages.original: פְּ֭דֵנִי מֵעֹ֣שֶׁק אָדָ֑ם וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
passages.sermon: The speaker is God's servant.\r\nThe servant asks God to make His face shine on him.\r\nThe servant asks God to teach him God's statutes.
passages.original: פָּ֭נֶיךָ הָאֵ֣ר בְּעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝לַמְּדֵ֗נִי אֶת־ חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a servant of God.
The speaker sees that people do not obey God's law.
The speaker feels deep sorrow.
Tears flow from the speaker's eyes like streams of water.
The speaker weeps because people ignore God's law.
passages.original: פַּלְגֵי־ מַ֭יִם יָרְד֣וּ עֵינָ֑י עַ֝֗ל לֹא־ שָׁמְר֥וּ תוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
passages.sermon: The LORD is righteous.\r\nThe LORD is just.\r\nThe LORD’s judgments are upright.
passages.original: צַדִּ֣יק אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
passages.sermon:
God, You gave testimonies.
Your testimonies are righteous.
Your testimonies are completely faithful.
passages.original: צִ֭וִּיתָ צֶ֣דֶק עֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ וֶֽאֱמוּנָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
passages.sermon:
I have great zeal.
My zeal overwhelms me.
My enemies forget Your words.
Their forgetfulness causes my zeal to consume me.
passages.original: צִמְּתַ֥תְנִי קִנְאָתִ֑י כִּֽי־ שָׁכְח֖וּ דְבָרֶ֣יךָ צָרָֽי׃

passages.text: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
passages.sermon:
God speaks promises.
God’s promise is completely pure.
God’s servant loves God’s pure promise.
passages.original: צְרוּפָ֖ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ מְאֹ֗ד וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ אֲהֵבָֽהּ׃

passages.text: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
passages.sermon: I am lowly.\r\nPeople despise me.\r\nI do not forget Your precepts.
passages.original: צָעִ֣יר אָנֹכִ֣י וְנִבְזֶ֑ה פִּ֝קֻּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

passages.text: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
passages.sermon: God is righteous.\r\nGod’s righteousness lasts forever.\r\nGod’s law is true.
passages.original: צִדְקָתְךָ֣ צֶ֣דֶק לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ אֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
passages.sermon:
I feel trouble.
I feel distress.
These things have found me.
Your commandments give me delight.
Your commandments bring me joy.
passages.original: צַר־ וּמָצ֥וֹק מְצָא֑וּנִי מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃

passages.text: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
passages.sermon:
God’s testimonies are always righteous.
They are righteous forever.
God, give me understanding.
If You give me understanding, I will live.
passages.original: צֶ֖דֶק עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ לְעוֹלָ֗ם הֲבִינֵ֥נִי וְאֶחְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
passages.sermon: I call to You with all my heart.\r\nO LORD, answer me.\r\nI will obey Your statutes.
passages.original: קָרָ֣אתִי בְכָל־ לֵ֭ב עֲנֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה׃

passages.text: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
passages.sermon: I call to You, Lord.\r\nSave me.\r\nI want to keep Your testimonies.
passages.original: קְרָאתִ֥יךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
passages.sermon: I rise before dawn.\r\nI cry out for help.\r\nI put my hope in Your word.
passages.original: קִדַּ֣מְתִּי בַ֭נֶּשֶׁף וָאֲשַׁוֵּ֑עָה לִדְבָרֶיךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

passages.text: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
passages.sermon:
I am a person who seeks God.
I look forward to the night watches.
My eyes stay open during the night.
I do this so I can think about Your word.
I meditate on what You have spoken.
passages.original: קִדְּמ֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי אַשְׁמֻר֑וֹת לָ֝שִׂ֗יחַ בְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
passages.sermon:
LORD, you are loving and faithful.
Hear my voice.
Show me your kindness.
Give me life.
Act with your justice.
passages.original: ק֭וֹלִי שִׁמְעָ֣ה כְחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
passages.sermon:
Wicked people come close to me.
They chase after evil.
They do not follow Your law.
They stay far away from Your teachings.
passages.original: קָ֭רְבוּ רֹדְפֵ֣י זִמָּ֑ה מִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ רָחָֽקוּ׃

passages.text: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is near.
The LORD is present.
All the LORD’s commandments are true.
The LORD’s words are trustworthy.
The LORD’s instructions are reliable.
passages.original: קָר֣וֹב אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל־ מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
passages.sermon:
God gave testimonies.
God’s testimonies are His laws and commands.
I learned from God’s testimonies a long time ago.
God established His testimonies forever.
God’s testimonies will never end.
passages.original: קֶ֣דֶם יָ֭דַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְסַדְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, I am suffering.
See my affliction.
Rescue me.
I have not forgotten Your law.
passages.original: רְאֵֽה־ עָנְיִ֥י וְחַלְּצֵ֑נִי כִּי־ תֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

passages.text: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
passages.sermon:
God, you are my defender.
Defend my cause.
Redeem me.
Give me life by your word.
passages.original: רִיבָ֣ה רִ֭יבִי וּגְאָלֵ֑נִי לְאִמְרָתְךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
passages.sermon: The wicked do not seek God's statutes.\r\nSalvation stays far from the wicked.
passages.original: רָח֣וֹק מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים יְשׁוּעָ֑ה כִּֽי־ חֻ֝קֶּיךָ לֹ֣א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃

passages.text: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
passages.sermon:
The LORD has great mercies.
The LORD shows much compassion.
LORD, give me life by Your ordinances.
Your judgments bring life.
I ask You to revive me as You have decreed.
passages.original: רַחֲמֶ֖יךָ רַבִּ֥ים׀ יְהוָ֑ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
passages.sermon:
Many people persecute me.
Many people oppose me.
I have not turned away from Your testimonies.
I remain faithful to Your words.
passages.original: רַ֭בִּים רֹדְפַ֣י וְצָרָ֑י מֵ֝עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃

passages.text: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
passages.sermon: The psalmist sees people who are faithless.\r\nThese people do not keep God's word.\r\nThe psalmist feels loathing when he sees them.
passages.original: רָאִ֣יתִי בֹ֭גְדִים וָֽאֶתְקוֹטָ֑טָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֝מְרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃

passages.text: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
passages.sermon: O LORD, I love Your precepts.\r\nYou show loving devotion.\r\nGive me life because of Your loving devotion.
passages.original: רְ֭אֵה כִּי־ פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ אָהָ֑בְתִּי יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
passages.sermon:
God speaks truth in every word.
God’s word is always true.
God’s judgments are righteous.
God’s righteous judgments last forever.
passages.original: רֹאשׁ־ דְּבָרְךָ֥ אֱמֶ֑ת וּ֝לְעוֹלָ֗ם כָּל־ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
passages.sermon:
Rulers attack me.
They have no reason to do this.
My heart does not fear them.
My heart fears only Your word, Lord.
passages.original: שָׂ֭רִים רְדָפ֣וּנִי חִנָּ֑ם וּמִדְּבָרֶיךָ פָּחַ֥ד לִבִּֽי׃

passages.text: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist feels great joy because of God's promise.
The psalmist rejoices in God's word.
The psalmist feels like a person who finds much treasure.
God's promise brings the psalmist happiness and excitement.
passages.original: שָׂ֣שׂ אָ֭נֹכִֽי עַל־ אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כְּ֝מוֹצֵ֗א שָׁלָ֥ל רָֽב׃

passages.text: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
passages.sermon: I hate falsehood.\r\nI abhor lies.\r\nI love Your law.
passages.original: שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂ֭נֵאתִי וַאֲתַעֵ֑בָה תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ אָהָֽבְתִּי׃

passages.text: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a faithful servant of God.
The speaker praises God seven times each day.
The speaker praises God because God’s judgments are righteous.
God’s judgments are always right and just.
The speaker gives thanks to God many times every day.
passages.original: שֶׁ֣בַע בַּ֭יּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּ֑יךָ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your instruction; nothing can make them stumble.
passages.sermon:
This passage speaks about people who love God's instruction.
These people love God's law.
They receive abundant peace.
Nothing causes them to stumble.
Nothing makes them fall.
passages.original: שָׁל֣וֹם רָ֭ב לְאֹהֲבֵ֣י תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְאֵֽין־ לָ֥מוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל׃

passages.text: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
passages.sermon: The speaker addresses the LORD.\r\nThe speaker waits for the LORD’s salvation.\r\nThe speaker obeys the LORD’s commandments.
passages.original: שִׂבַּ֣רְתִּי לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ עָשִֽׂיתִי׃

passages.text: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
passages.sermon: I obey Your testimonies.\r\nI love Your testimonies very much.
passages.original: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי עֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ וָאֹהֲבֵ֥ם מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
passages.sermon:
I obey Your precepts.
I obey Your testimonies.
You see all my ways.
All my actions are before You.
passages.original: שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי פִ֭קּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י כָל־ דְּרָכַ֣י נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
passages.sermon:
I speak to the LORD.
I bring my cry before Him.
I ask the LORD to listen to me.
I ask Him to give me understanding.
I want understanding that matches His word.
passages.original: תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker brings a plea before the LORD.
The speaker asks the LORD to let this plea come before Him.
The speaker asks the LORD to rescue him.
The speaker asks for rescue according to the LORD’s promise.
passages.original: תָּב֣וֹא תְּחִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כְּ֝אִמְרָתְךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker’s lips pour forth praise.
The LORD teaches the speaker His statutes.
The speaker praises because the LORD teaches him.
passages.original: תַּבַּ֣עְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י תְּהִלָּ֑ה כִּ֖י תְלַמְּדֵ֣נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses God.
The speaker uses their tongue to speak about God's word.
The speaker sings about God's word.
God's commandments are righteous.
The speaker sings because all of God's commandments are righteous.
passages.original: תַּ֣עַן לְ֭שׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י כָל־ מִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ צֶּֽדֶק׃

passages.text: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
passages.sermon:
God, I ask for Your help.
I want Your hand to be ready to help me.
I have chosen Your precepts.
I follow Your commands.
That is why I ask for Your help.
passages.original: תְּהִֽי־ יָדְךָ֥ לְעָזְרֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ בָחָֽרְתִּי׃

passages.text: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker feels deep longing for the LORD’s salvation.
The speaker finds joy in the LORD’s law.
The LORD’s law gives the speaker delight.
passages.original: תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝תֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃

passages.text: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
passages.sermon:
I am the speaker in this prayer.
I ask God to let my soul live.
I want to praise God.
I ask God’s judgments to help me.
God’s judgments can sustain me.
passages.original: תְּֽחִי־ נַ֭פְשִׁי וּֽתְהַֽלְלֶ֑ךָּ וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ יַעֲזְרֻֽנִי׃

passages.text: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a servant of the LORD.
The speaker has strayed.
The speaker is like a lost sheep.
The speaker asks the LORD to seek him.
The speaker has not forgotten the LORD’s commandments.
passages.original: תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֭בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
